messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands in the center of the room, then turns his body in a slow circle, briefly raising his right hand to his face before lowering it.","camera":"The camera maintains a full-body shot and orbits around the man as he turns, keeping him centered in the frame.","clothing":"He wears a dark blue, form-fitting uniform with a high collar, a gold belt, a gold chest emblem, and a red patch on the right sleeve.","hair_color":"Unclear, as the head is fully covered by the cap.","hairstyle":"Hair is not visible, covered by a white peaked cap.","identity":"A 3D animated man with a dark complexion, slim build, and a white peaked cap.","scene":"The setting is a large, futuristic circular room with a reflective floor, glowing pink and blue neon lights, and a large digital ring display in the background."},"uncertain":["hair_color"]}}

arguments.observed_change: The desert ruins and waterfront background were replaced with a large futuristic circular room featuring reflective flooring, pink/blue neon lighting, glass panels, and a glowing digital ring display. The man remains in a dark blue uniform with white cap, gold belt, and similar insignia, and performs the same standing, turning, and hand-to-face motion. The camera continues a full-body orbit around him, and his lighting now reflects the neon environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source scene with the futuristic neon environment from the reference image while preserving the man's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and the camera framing/movement, and adapt his lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Hair color cannot be verified because the cap fully covers the head.
unexpected_changes: The target environment appears as an interior circular room rather than the exact exterior building view shown in the reference image.
